title: ai-agent operations
description: ai-agent's commands, reached as `zazzle agent llm|prompt` or `zazzle ai-agent COMMAND` (the invoker execs `zazzle daemon llm`, which execs ai-agent; `zazzle agent status|prune` is not routed there and reaches ai-agent-rules instead), by daemon running `ai-agent prompt --no-download` as a child for an agent's `--llm`, `brief` and `prompt` (src/macos/daemon/src/llm.rs), or by running the binary directly. An error prints `error: ...` on standard error and exits 2.

entities.name: zazzle agent llm
entities.description: Lists the model catalogue; or downloads a model and makes it, and an effort, the default; or removes a downloaded model.
entities.transport: zazzle agent llm [--model NAME] [--effort low|medium|high] | --remove NAME (ai-agent llm ..)
entities.authorization: None checked: the caller's own permissions on the model directory.
entities.result: With no option, the catalogue (name, size, downloaded or not, what it is for, the default marked) with the default model, effort and model directory; with --model or --effort, `default: MODEL at effort EFFORT`; with --remove, `removed NAME` or `NAME was not downloaded`.
failures: An unknown or ambiguous model name.
An effort other than low, medium or high.
A failed or mismatching model download.
The directory or defaults file cannot be written; HOME is unset and ZAZZLE_LLM_DIR is not given.

entities.name: zazzle agent prompt
entities.description: Asks a model and streams its answer, downloading the model first when it is missing unless --no-download is given.
entities.transport: zazzle agent prompt [--model NAME] [--effort E] [--system TEXT] [--max-tokens N] [--show-thinking] [--no-download] [--grammar GBNF] [--temp T] [TEXT.. | -] (ai-agent prompt ..)
entities.authorization: None checked: the caller's own permissions.
entities.result: The answer on standard output; the thinking on standard error with --show-thinking; exit 0, or 3 with a note on standard error when the token limit cut the answer short. --grammar holds the answer to a GBNF grammar (root rule `root`); --temp sets the sampling temperature (default 0.7; 0 takes the likeliest token every time). It changes nothing but the model store, when it downloads the model; while it runs it holds a shared lock on the model's lock file, so prune leaves the model alone.
failures: An unknown or ambiguous model name, or an unknown effort.
An empty prompt: `nothing to ask: give TEXT, or pipe it in`.
A failed or mismatching model download.
With --no-download, a model that is not downloaded: `error: NAME is not downloaded (SIZE): run `zazzle agent llm --model NAME` first`, exit 4.
A model that cannot be loaded or has no usable chat template.
A prompt as long as the model's training context or longer.
prune removed the model between the download check and the shared lock: `error: FILE was removed while starting; run again`.

entities.name: zazzle ai-agent status
entities.description: Reports the model store: the default model and effort, each downloaded model with its size and check, partial downloads, the store path and disk use, and this program's version.
entities.authorization: None checked: the caller's own permissions on the model directory.
entities.result: Text: `default: MODEL at effort E (downloaded|not downloaded)`, one line per model file in models/ (`*` marks the default; `ok (size)`, `ok (sha256)`, `CORRUPT: ..` or `not in the catalogue`, `, in use` when its lock is held), partial downloads with their size, the expected size and `stale` or `downloading`, `store: PATH (N GB on disk)`, `problem: ..` lines and `ai-agent VERSION`. --json prints one object: tool `ai-agent`, version, ok, store, disk_bytes, default {model, effort, downloaded}, models [{name, file, bytes, expected_bytes, check (size, sha256, corrupt or unknown), default, in_use}], partials [{name, file, bytes, expected_bytes, downloading}] and problems. A model is checked by size; --verify also hashes it against the catalogue's SHA-256. Exit 0 when ok, 1 when the default model is not downloaded (or not in the catalogue) or a model is corrupt. Nothing is written.
failures: With --verify, a model file that cannot be read: `error: reading PATH: ..`, exit 2.
HOME is unset and ZAZZLE_LLM_DIR is not given: exit 2.

entities.name: zazzle ai-agent prune
entities.description: Frees disk space in the model store: every downloaded model except the default, partial downloads (except the missing default's, which resumes) and lock files of models with nothing left; a dry run unless --apply.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond the locks: a model whose lock a download, prompt or worker holds is skipped; with --apply prune takes each model's lock exclusively without waiting while it deletes that model's files.
entities.result: `would remove:` (or with --apply `removed:`) and one line per file: size, path and why (`model NAME`, `stale partial download of NAME`, `orphaned lock of NAME`); `skipped: NAME (in use: ..)` for a held lock; `kept: NAME (the default)`; then `would free N GB: run `zazzle ai-agent prune --apply` to delete`, `freed N GB` or `nothing to prune`. Exit 0, or 2 when a file could not be removed; the default model is never deleted.
failures: A file that cannot be removed or a lock that cannot be opened: `error: ..` lines after the report, the rest still pruned, exit 2.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases that call these commands.
`zazzle daemon llm`, the way in from zazzle.
zazzle's brief and prompt, which call `prompt --no-download`.
Post-processing with `--llm` and brief, which call `prompt --no-download` with --grammar and --temp.
